title: Taxonomy Field: Categories and Tags on Your Content | Orchard Core
description:
A taxonomy only organizes content once content items are linked to its terms. Without a field that points to the taxonomy, editors have nowhere to choose a category or a tag.

The Taxonomy Field attaches the terms of one taxonomy to a content type. It has a Standard editor, which shows every term as a checkbox or a radio button, and a Tags editor, where editors type to search and can create tags as they go.

In this video:
• How a Taxonomy Field, its editors and its display modes work
• Adding a Category field with the Standard editor, and the Unique and Leaves only settings
• Adding a Tags field with the Tags editor, the Open setting and the Tags display mode
• Choosing a category and tags while editing a post, and creating a tag on the spot
• Seeing the category and the tags on the site
